title: How to Run A User Research Recap Like An Expert
summary: Hannah Kirkbride on how to run expert research recaps on a regular basis to help your stakeholders cut through the noise and stay current with research.
body_markdown: Hannah Kirkbride is a freelance design researcher based in South Wales, UK. Hannah has over eight years of experience leading high impact research that empowers designers to make confident, user-centred decisions. She writes a weekly Substack newsletter for curious creatives called[The Research Objective](https://theresearchobjective.substack.com/) , where she explores the ups and downs of freelancing, snippets of her work as a design researcher, and much more.
